title: Mail Nearly Halved While The Stamp Price More Than Doubled
hook: Mailing a letter cost 68 cents even as mail volume nearly halved.
closing: Less mail does not mean cheaper postage; a thinning mailbox can still come with rising costs.
question: What still makes you buy a stamp?

segments.say: Total mail volume fell to 109 billion pieces in the supplied latest year. The peak was nearly twice as high.
First-Class Mail fell to 46 billion pieces in the measured comparison. Its decline outpaced the overall mail contraction.
The stamp price reached 68 cents in the supplied historical comparison. That more than doubled the earlier price.
